concepts.name: 01-midnight-observatory
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished high-fidelity desktop web app main dashboard concept for DreamThread, a personal AI dream journal that connects recurring dreams with inspectable evidence. Landscape 16:10 composition, straight-on full interface screenshot, no laptop/device frame, no external presentation border, no collage. This is a functional signed-in home screen, with tasteful product design, excellent readable typography, deliberate spacing, refined icons, clear hierarchy and a cohesive imaginative visual world. Brand text "DreamThread". Include navigation for "Journal", "Constellation", "Dream Detective"; greeting "Good morning, Sarah"; primary capture action "Record a dream" with microphone and text options; recent dream entries "The house in the forest", "An ocean without edges", "The familiar stranger"; a connection insight "The house returned in 3 dreams" with "View sources"; some interactive-looking constellation nodes with real labels and obvious clickable controls. Use concise readable text, no dense placeholder paragraphs, no fake browser chrome, no watermarks. Dream visuals should support usable UI.
Direction 01: Midnight Observatory. Deep midnight navy and ink-black atmospheric background, restrained violet and icy mint accents, fine starfield, elegant thin orbital lines. Spacious slim left navigation rail. Main left column an editorial greeting and prominent beautiful dream capture panel. Main right a large sophisticated interactive constellation canvas of connected glowing celestial dream nodes, with a focused House node revealing an evidence popover. Bottom row three dream journal cards with tiny surreal photographic thumbnails. Premium scientific observatory meets intimate journal, crisp sans typography with a restrained elegant serif headline, sophisticated luminous depth rather than excessive blur. Very dark beautiful clear application UI.
